sclc_pt01_classic_ascl1_bcl2_hyperdepend.citation: George et al. (2015) Nature 524:47-53; Horn et al. (2018) NEJM (IMpower133 - Atezolizumab); Paz-Ares et al. (2019) Lancet (CASPIAN - Durvalumab)

clinical_history.primary_driver: Obligate biallelic TP53 and RB1 loss, high ASCL1 driving massive BCL2
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Brief partial response for 3.8 mo, rapid brain metastases, death at 7.5 mo

sclc_pt02_slfn11_loss_acquired_chemo_ref.title: Patient sclc_pt02_slfn11_loss_acquired_chemo_refractory: SLFN11-Epigenetically Silenced Platinum-Resistant SCLC

clinical_history.primary_driver: Biallelic loss of TP53/RB1, secondary SLFN11 methylation
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Primary refractory, rapid progression at 2.1 mo, death at 4.2 mo
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Loss of SLFN11 allows cancer cells to bypass replication fork stalling and DNA crosslinks
